title: University battle royale
narrator: Deadpan documentary: calm and dry, treats the impossible premise like a serious report. The jokes land through understatement.
logline: Five schools, no weapons, a shrinking zone. Called like a title fight; the trophy says Participant.

cues.onScreen: What if colleges had a battle royale?
cues.narration: What if colleges had a battle royale?
cues.delivery: Straight question, as if it were a policy proposal.

cues.onScreen: Five schools enter: Stanford, Berkeley, Harvard, MIT, UCLA.
cues.narration: Five schools enter. Stanford, Berkeley, Harvard, MIT, UCLA.
cues.delivery: Even beat per name, like a roll call.

cues.onScreen: No weapons. Just trivia, robots, and dance-offs.
cues.narration: No weapons. Just trivia, robots, and dance-offs.
The zone starts shrinking. Everyone heads for the quad.
Round 1: MIT's robot faces UCLA in a dance-off. The robot can dance. UCLA is out.
cues.delivery: Report it like a surprising lab result.

cues.onScreen: Round 2: Berkeley wins the chant battle.
cues.narration: Round 2: Berkeley wins the chant battle. Nobody else was close.

cues.onScreen: Round 3: Harvard wins trivia. It's been studying since 1636.
cues.narration: Round 3: trivia. Harvard wins. It has been studying since 1636.

cues.onScreen: Round 4: Stanford uses its 8,353 acres to dodge.

cues.narration: Final two: Stanford and Harvard. Both have prepared statements.
And the winner receives... a plaque that says Participant.
Who do you think should win?

notes: All eliminations and the result are fictional (v12.h.outcomes); rules are stated on screen up front (v12.a.rules).
